displayName: Panoptent — Click & Edit with Claude Code
description: Click any element in your running app, say what to change — Claude Code edits the source. Visual editing for VS Code and Chrome.
config.language: Language of the Panoptent interface (preview panel, overlay, Chrome extension, notifications and the prompts sent to Claude).
config.language.auto: Follow VS Code's display language (English if not supported)
config.defaultUrl: Dev server address the preview opens.
config.sendTo: Where the selected element and request are sent.
config.openSourceOnSelect: When you select an element in the preview, open its source file at the matching line in the editor without taking focus from the preview.
config.claudePath: Claude Code CLI command or full path.
config.permissionMode: Claude Code permission mode. acceptEdits: allows file edits and rejects other terminal commands (recommended).
config.model: Optional model name (e.g. sonnet, opus). Leave empty to use the Claude Code default.
config.reloadAfterEdit: Fully reload the preview when Claude finishes. Not needed for projects with hot reload (Vite, Next, Nuxt).
config.chromeBridge: Open the local bridge so the Chrome extension can connect to this VS Code window (127.0.0.1 only; asks for approval on first connection).
config.bridgePort: First port the Chrome bridge tries (if taken, the next 9 ports are tried).
config.mcpServer: Run a local MCP server (127.0.0.1 only) so AI agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Windsurf can read the selected elements, the queue and the page context, and mark changes as applied.
config.mcpPort: First port the MCP server tries (if taken, the next 9 ports are tried). The address is http://127.0.0.1:PORT/mcp.
config.sendTo.claudePanel: Hands the request to the Claude Code panel in VS Code (prefilled; you press Enter).
config.sendTo.cli: Runs the Claude Code CLI in the background; progress shows in the Panoptent panel.
config.sendTo.mcp: Claude Code reads the changes itself through Panoptent's MCP server: Apply copies a one-line command instead of attaching a request file (or type /mcp__panoptent__apply_queue in Claude Code). Panoptent offers to connect Claude Code the first time.
config.designFile: Design rules file Claude should follow for UI changes, relative to the project folder (e.g. `design.md`). Empty: automatic (uses `design.md`, `DESIGN.md` or `docs/design.md` if present). `off`: disabled. Easiest to set with [Panoptent: Choose Design Rules File](command:panoptent.chooseDesignFile).
view.home.welcome:
Preview your app, click an element, type what you want — Claude Code edits the code.
[$(eye) Open Preview](command:panoptent.open)
Start your project's dev server first (e.g. npm run dev).
[$(wand) Set Up code-inspector Automatically](command:panoptent.setupCodeInspector)
Links elements to their exact file and line, so Claude doesn't spend time and tokens searching.
[$(book) Setup Guide](command:panoptent.setupGuide)
[$(gear) Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22panoptent%22%5D)
[$(globe) Language: English / Türkçe](command:panoptent.changeLanguage)
